title: Components: Props, Emits & Slots
objectives: Compose with slots and named slots
body:
# Components: Props, Emits & Slots ## Explicit contracts ```html ``` Everything a component consumes or announces is visible in one glance — the signature IS the documentation. ## Events flow up ```html ``` Never mutate props. If a child must change state, it emits; the owner decides. This keeps every mutation traceable to one place. ## Slots: composition points ```html

Default slot content here.

 ``` ```html
``` Slots make components *shells* — layout without content coupling (this app's `OutputPanel` tabs use exactly this pattern). ## v-model on components ```ts const model = defineModel() // Vue 3.4+: two-way binding done right ``` Use sparingly — form controls mainly; anything else prefers emit-based flow.

examples.name: StatCard.vue
examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
defineProps<{ label: string; value: number }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'select'): void }>()
</script>

<template>
  <button class="stat" @click="emit('select')">
    <slot name="icon">📊</slot>
    {{ label }}: {{ value }}
  </button>
</template>
